name: Dash Digital Studio
mood: Editorial museum on warm paper, with giant whisper-weight typography, off-white gallery walls, full-bleed product photography, and zero chromatic accent.

carbonBlack.role: Primary text, nav links, body copy, badge text, footer copy, and structural borders.

bone.role: Default page canvas and primary surface.

ink.role: Maximum contrast text and hard borders, reserved for strongest emphasis.

linen.role: Slightly elevated sheet surface and subtle section separation.

ash.role: Muted fills, hairline borders, and disabled or inactive surfaces.

stone.role: Deep low-emphasis gray for supporting details.

clay.role: Warm mid-gray transition between Bone and Parchment.

families.foundersGroteskFallback: Sohne, Inter, GT America, Neue Haas Grotesk, ui-sans-serif, system-ui
families.editorialNeueFallback: Tiempos Text, Lyon Display, Source Serif Pro, serif

rules: Use Founders Grotesk style type as the sole workhorse family.
Use weight 300 only for display sizes 40px and above.
Use weight 400 for body, nav, meta, labels, and descriptions.
Use tonal surface shifts and 1px hairline rules for separation.
Keep images, cards, and buttons flat.

components.name: Pill Action Button
components.role: Primary action for case study and work links
components.recipe: Solid #2a2a2a background, #fafafa uppercase 12px Founders Grotesk style text, 999px radius, about 14px horizontal and 4px vertical padding, no border, no shadow.

components.name: Text Nav Link
components.recipe: 12-14px uppercase Founders Grotesk style text, #2a2a2a, no underline, no background, no border, about 29px horizontal spacing.

components.name: Editorial Display Heading
components.recipe: 70-101px uppercase Founders Grotesk style text, weight 300, #2a2a2a, line-height 0.80-0.88, tight negative tracking.

components.name: Case Study Card
components.recipe: 2-up grid column with uppercase 12px meta, 20px title gap, 22px uppercase title, and full-bleed 0px-radius product photograph.

components.name: Brand List Row
components.recipe: Full-width row with 1px #2a2a2a bottom border, uppercase brand left, uppercase service tags and MORE + pill right.

components.name: Text Input
components.recipe: 1px #2a2a2a border, 4px radius, no fill, 16px Founders Grotesk style text, no colored focus ring.

do: Set hero and section titles at 70-101px with compressed leading.
Use Carbon Black for running text.
Use Bone as the main page background.
Use 999px radius only for pill buttons and tags.
Use 80-120px vertical gaps between major sections.
Render actions as uppercase dark pills.
dont: Do not use weight 300 for body text.
Do not apply shadows, glows, or gradients.
Do not add decorative icons or illustrations.

imagery.style: Full-bleed product photography in raw rectangular frames.
rules: Use no rounded corners, borders, shadows, overlays, or duotone effects.
Let product photography carry visual energy while the UI remains neutral.
Avoid illustrations and decorative icon systems.

layout.hero: Pure typographic block with massive uppercase display and no hero image.
layout.grid: 2-up case study grid with 29px column gaps.
layout.sections: Wide whitespace, sparse hairline rules, no colorful bands.
layout.rhythm: Whitespace, typographic mass, product image grid, client rows, hairline table, repeat.

preview.note: Refero exposes preview imagery, but local download was not captured in this environment.
